brief:
Israeli restrictions and funding shortages are forcing aid organizations to scale back operations in Gaza, leaving hundreds of thousands of Palestinians without access to food assistance, Mondoweiss reported. The pullback marks a critical moment as the territory faces mounting food insecurity amid the ongoing humanitarian emergency.

The withdrawal comes as organizations struggle against Israeli constraints on aid delivery and insufficient international funding to sustain operations. Palestinians across Gaza now confront a new phase of severe hunger, with shrinking humanitarian infrastructure unable to meet basic needs across the population.
dek: Israeli restrictions and funding shortages are threatening one of Gaza's last lifelines as Palestinians face a new phase of severe food insecurity.
title: Aid groups withdraw from Gaza as food crisis deepens
